semiconductor_relevance: Medium — T.S.J is involved in the refurbishment and resale of used semiconductor equipment, which is a niche but important part of the semiconductor equipment supply chain.
summary: T.S.J specializes in providing tailored solutions for used semiconductor equipment, including purchasing, refurbishing, and reselling idle equipment and production lines. The company also offers equipment relocation and dismantling services, supported by a professional team, to meet specific customer needs.
capabilities: Modification and repair services for semiconductor equipment
Relocation services within factories or cleanrooms
Dismantling services for individual equipment pieces
end_markets: Manufacturing facilities requiring equipment upgrades or relocations
